text: In March 2022, faced with Western sanctions over Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Aeroflot stopped almost all of its international flights.

source.name: Fortune: Russia’s flag carrier, Aeroflot, is canceling its international flights to stop foreign governments seizing its planes
source.quote: Aeroflot, is halting almost all its international flights over fears that its planes will be impounded overseas by countries that have imposed sanctions on Russia’s aviation industry

additionalSources.name: Al Jazeera: Aeroflot halting all foreign flights, minus Belarus, from March 8
additionalSources.quote: suspending all international flights – except to neighbouring Belarus – starting on March 8, as Moscow faces a sweeping range of Western sanctions over its invasion of Ukraine.
